696e831d-50d3-49a7-aafb-ee94ab920a77.quote: We won the duo lane clean — first blood at 2.7, first Fangtooth, zero duo deaths before 10 to their three — and three of five role matchups read favorably at some point. The 18-minute teamfight, traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead, cost our first tower at 18.8. We answered by winning the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and taking Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window. From 27 to 35 minutes the game turned: Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost an Inner Tower, Morigesh's at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute, and Khaimera's three late solo catches fed the Primal Fangtooth, an Inhibitor, and the Core. We still won the last fight, at 35.7, 2-1, but the Core had already fallen. Majors finished 22-19 ours, fights 4-0 ours, towers 4-9 theirs.

The 18-minute teamfight, traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead, cost our first tower at 18.8. We answered by winning the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and taking Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window. The game turned in the 27-to-35-minute stretch. Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost an Inner Tower, Morigesh's catch at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute, and Khaimera's three late solo catches fed the Primal Fangtooth, an Inhibitor, and the Core. We still won the last fight, at 35.7, 2-1, but the Core had already fallen. Majors finished 22-19 ours, fights 4-0 ours, towers 4-9 theirs.
